step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture shows real-time cloud security event collection and evaluation using AWS services. 1. External cloud providers' native security event streams enter the COLLECT Kinesis Data Stream. 2. Data flows into Neptune (graph database) for resource state graph representations. 3. Neptune replicates/synchronizes data across search and metric databases: Elasticsearch, CloudWatch, and DynamoDB. 4. Elasticsearch metrics feed into CloudWatch, and CloudWatch metrics feed a sharder loop back into COLLECT Kinesis Data Streams / Neptune. 5. Security events flow from COLLECT Kinesis Data Streams down to RULES Kinesis Data Streams. 6. RULES Kinesis Data Streams queries Neptune for security rule evaluation and writes detected violations to DynamoDB. 7. DynamoDB feeds notification channels (Slack and Email).
